valores.label: share of the Columbia River Basin's area in Canada

fonte: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and Bonneville Power Administration (U.S. Entity), 'Columbia River Treaty: History and 2014/2024 Review' (sem data impressa; c. 2013)
legenda: Basin: all the land that drains into the river.
credito_sugerido: Source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers & Bonneville Power Administration, 2013
nota: 'only about 15 percent of the 259,500 square miles of the Columbia River Basin is actually located in Canada' (USACE + BPA). Confere com o USGS (2007: 14.95 %) e com a BC Hydro 2026 ('Canada has 15% of the basin area'). O documento do USACE + BPA não traz data impressa; o '2013' do crédito é a datação do dossiê (fase da revisão 2014/2024).
